Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring public agencies to post certain information to their web sites.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to posting information on public agencies' websites; and adding a new section to chapter 42.30 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.30 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Every public agency that owns or maintains a public internetweb site shall post to it all ordinances, resolutions, rules,regulations, orders, and directives adopted by its governing bodywithin five business days of adoption. The minutes of all regular andspecial meetings of the governing body of every public agency that ownsor maintains such a web site shall also be posted within five businessdays of the meetings. (2) Every public agency that owns or maintains a public internetweb site shall post to it a schedule of the time and place of allregular meetings of the governing body. Except in cases of emergency,the public agency shall promptly post to its web site a notice of thetime and place of all special meetings of the governing body. (3) Every public agency that owns or maintains a public internetweb site shall at all times have posted to it a roster of the names of p. 1 SB 5420all members of its governing body, identifying the positions, andconstituency where applicable, of all members. The web site shall atall times provide both the start date and end date of the elective orappointed terms of all members. (4) This section shall not be construed to affect existing publicagency notice requirements in RCW 42.30.060 and 42.30.075.
